lina (PM): quick decision thread on headroom rebalancer + guardrails for dedicated pools. need something that's predictable and explainable for customers.

sam (Eng-Platform): propose a two-phase admit: 1) evaluate hard constraints (explicit_guarantee / compliance_flag), 2) soft scoring (sla_weight, committed_ratio, recent_burn). keep runtime path branchy but cheap.

nora (SRE): must include safety caps: per-pool donor rate limit, donor backpressure (don't steal from donors with >80% recent CPU/KV hits), and a fast circuit that disables rebalancer for N minutes if p99 rises.

gabe (Customer Success): customers expect clear UX: when we "rebalance" show "source pool" -> "destination" and a reason code; for compliance customers, provide an explicit opt-out.

sam (Eng-Platform): pseudocode for fast path:

```
if (tenant.hard_reserved) return LOCAL_ONLY
if (tenant.opt_out_cross_region) return QUEUE
flags = cached_flags(tenant) // 3s
score = sla_weight*100 + committed_ratio*50 - burn_score*2
if (score >= admit_threshold && donor_ok(pool)) ADMIT else QUEUE
```

nora (SRE): metrics & rollout: canary p99 delta <=4%, donor-preemption events <=1/day per-donor, cross-region rebalance <0.15% requests. auto-disable rebalancer when pool_p99 uplift >8% in 1m.

lina (PM): deliverables: sam -> implement cached evaluator + donor_ok check; nora -> define concrete thresholds & alerting playbooks; gabe -> UX reason-code list + opt-out copy; i'll write rollout checklist and customer comms. target: staged canary in two weeks.
